0022600202.text: As of today, the Miami Heat (3-6, 10th in the East) are on a one-game losing streak and have a 2-3 road record, while the Sacramento Kings (1-7, 15th in the West) are also on a one-game skid. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Heat winning their most recent meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
